mapper.select:
select
(select count(*) from `user` where user_type = 1) as total_users,
(select count(*) from `user` u where u.user_type = 1 and u.status = 1 and (exists (select 1 from consultation_session cs where cs.user_id = u.id and cs.started_at >= #{activeSince}) or exists (select 1 from emotion_diary ed where ed.user_id = u.id and ed.diary_date >= #{activeSince})) ) as active_users,
(select count(*) from emotion_diary) as total_diaries,
(select count(*) from emotion_diary where created_at >= #{today} and created_at < date_add(#{today}, interval 1 day) ) as today_new_diaries,
(select count(*) from consultation_session) as total_sessions,
(select count(*) from consultation_session where started_at >= #{today} and started_at < date_add(#{today}, interval 1 day) ) as today_new_sessions,
(select coalesce(round(avg(mood_score), 1), 0) from emotion_diary) as avg_mood_score

select diary_date as date, coalesce(round(avg(mood_score), 1), 0) as avg_mood_score, count(*) as record_count from emotion_diary where diary_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} group by diary_date order by diary_date

select count(*) as total_sessions,
coalesce(round(avg( timestampdiff( minute, cs.started_at, coalesce(m.max_created_at, cs.started_at) ) ), 1), 0) as avg_duration_minutes from consultation_session cs left join (
select session_id, max(created_at) as max_created_at from consultation_message group by session_id ) m on m.session_id = cs.id

select date(started_at) as date, count(*) as session_count, count(distinct user_id) as user_count from consultation_session where started_at >= #{startDate} and started_at < date_add(#{endDate}, interval 1 day) group by date(started_at) order by date(started_at)

select date(created_at) as date, count(*) as total from `user` where user_type = 1 and created_at >= #{startDate} and created_at < date_add(#{endDate}, interval 1 day) group by date(created_at) order by date(created_at)
select diary_date as date, count(distinct user_id) as total from emotion_diary where diary_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} group by diary_date order by diary_date

select date(started_at) as date, count(distinct user_id) as total from consultation_session where started_at >= #{startDate} and started_at < date_add(#{endDate}, interval 1 day) group by date(started_at) order by date(started_at)

select t.stat_date as date, count(distinct t.user_id) as total from ( select date(started_at) as stat_date, user_id from consultation_session where started_at >= #{startDate} and started_at < date_add(#{endDate}, interval 1 day)
union all
select diary_date as stat_date, user_id from emotion_diary where diary_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} ) t group by t.stat_date order by t.stat_date
